newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Fotex pays no dividend on 1996 results.
newsitem.headline: Fotex pays no dividend on 1996 results.

text.p: Shareholders of Hungarian retail group Fotex Rt approved on Thursday the board's proposal to pay no dividend on the company's 1996 results.
"We are carrying out a decision taken two years ago not to pay dividend for three years," Fotex Chairman and CEO Gabor Varszegi told shareholders.
The company last paid a 16 forints per share or 16 percent dividend on its 1993 results.
In 1996, Fotex's IAS group net profit dropped to 513.9 million forints from 851.5 in 1995 and 1.21 billion in 1994.

"The 1996 year did not bring the awaited improvement in Fotex's operating environment and this, together with the ongoing restructuring...affected our margins negatively," Fotex said in its annual report.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange, Fotex shares closed at 145 forints, down 4.
